core_obligations: Spread the map out (proof lines 1711-1714): there is an etale ring map A -> B' such that C is the base change of B' along A -> A_Z^tilde.

Make it faithfully flat (proof lines 1714-1718): the image U' of Spec(B') in Spec(A) is open and contains V(I), so there is f in the ideal with Spec(A) = U' union D(f); then A -> B' x A_f is etale and faithfully flat.

Localize the retraction (proof lines 1718-1719): by hypothesis there is a retraction B' x A_f -> A, and localizing it along A -> A_Z^tilde gives a retraction C -> A_Z^tilde of the given faithfully flat etale map, as required.
proof_roadmap: Descend the given etale algebra over the localization to an etale algebra over A.
Adjoin a localization to make it faithfully flat and invoke the hypothesis to obtain a retraction.
Localize that retraction back to the localization of A.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if every faithfully flat etale ring map out of A has a retraction, then the same holds for the localization A_Z^tilde along a closed subscheme Z (statement lines 1702-1709). The proof (proof lines 1711-1720) descends the given etale algebra to an etale algebra over A, adjoins a localization to make it faithfully flat, uses the hypothesis to get a retraction, and localizes it back. H2: a three-step descent-and-localize argument with three inputs, written out in full.
